summary: Cal Fire tower built in 1994 by a mining company to replace Hayden Hill Lookout; register says staffed in severe weather, and a July 2026 fire burned nearby.

facts.design: Tower with a spiral staircase; the register calls its design unique in the Cal Fire inventory
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection - Lassen-Modoc Unit (Cal Fire LMU)

events.note: Built by the Lassen Gold Mine Company for Cal Fire to replace Hayden Hill Lookout nine miles northeast; the mine took over the Hayden Hill site and the old lookout was torn down
Photo caption for a photo taken August 6, 2002 says the lookout was usually staffed during fire season
Register says staffed when severe weather was predicted, as of 2015
3-6 Fire burned about 5 acres in the Dixie Valley area near the lookout, reported July 16, 2026; aircraft and ground crews responded

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Peakbagging's 2002 photo caption says usually staffed during fire season; the register says staffed only when severe weather was predicted, as of 2015. Both are kept with their dates. The later register note is used as the current picture, but no recent schedule was found.

Peakbagging's photo page places the lookout in the Lassen National Forest, while its list page says the Plumas NF. The register names only the Cal Fire Lassen-Modoc Unit as administrator. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick a forest.

notes_for_editor: No access or visit information was found in any source, so facts.access and visit are omitted; the record's access 'unknown' stands. Height was not found. The no-rental line comes from an undated citlink.net copy of a CAL FIRE list; confirm on a current Cal Fire page. Peakbagging and the register disagree on the forest (Lassen vs Plumas) and on staffing; the story reports both. The July 2026 fire report says near the lookout, not at it. The register's photo credit (Ron Kemnow, 2008) is noted but no image URL was found, so no photo entry.
